enabledHelp: Lets eligible users sign in with the provider. It matches existing Jellyfin Users by username and verified email from the provider.
publicUrlHelp: Leave empty to use the browser address. Set this when Jellyfin is behind a reverse proxy or has more than one public address.
issuerUrlHelp: The provider's OpenID Connect issuer URL.
clientIdHelp: The client ID registered with the provider.
clientSecretHelp: The secret for this client ID.
userGroupHelp: List provider groups, separated by commas. Members can sign in and get a Jellyfin User if needed.
administratorGroupHelp: List provider groups, separated by commas. Members can sign in as Jellyfin administrators.
groupClaimHelp: Use a top-level claim that contains a string or an array of strings. Configure nested claims at the provider.
additionalScopesHelp: List scopes separated by spaces. The plugin also requests openid email profile. For example, Authelia needs groups to return group membership.
loginButtonTextHelp: The text shown on the Jellyfin login page.
passwordLoginModeHelp: Choose whether Jellyfin Users can also sign in with local passwords.
synchronizeProfileImagesHelp: Update a Jellyfin User's profile image when they sign in, using the provider's picture claim.
rpInitiatedLogoutHelp: Also sign out at the provider. Add <Public Jellyfin URL>/web/index.html to its post-logout redirect URIs.
groupValidation: Enter a User Group, an Administrator Group, or both.
localPasswordWarning: Local password sign-in will be disabled for {0}. After you save, test OIDC sign-in in a separate browser session before signing out.
